cohort: The study included 168 healthy normal weight women and 59 overweight/obese pregnant women, with the latter group further divided into those with normotensive pregnancy and those who developed preeclampsia.
finding: sHLA-G concentrations were found to be higher in normotensive overweight/obese women and their babies compared to controls, while they were lower in preeclamptic overweight/obese women and their cords.
